title: The resolved training job, as emitted by Job.to_dict()
description: The complete, validated description of one training run, after the registry ceiling has narrowed the manifest envelope. This document is embedded in the training result's provenance, so it is what a later reader uses to reconstruct the run.

key.description: The registry key selected via DIMER_PREPROCESSING_ARGS_JSON. This, not DIMER's Base Model field, is the authoritative runtime selector.

revision.description: An immutable commit SHA. Never a branch or tag — a job pinned to a moving ref is not reproducible.

effectiveBatchSize.description: Derived, and recorded because it is the number that actually governs the optimizer step — reading it off the two factors is a step a later reader should not have to take.

maxSequenceLength.description: Already clamped to the registry ceiling. The registry narrows the manifest envelope and never widens it.

weightDecay.description: AdamW decoupled weight decay, stated rather than inherited from the optimizer default. 0.0 is a legitimate choice for LoRA SFT and must stay expressible, so the lower bound is inclusive.

lrSchedulerType.description: `constant` reproduces the pre-control behaviour and is supported for exactly that reason: an existing registration must be able to keep the learning rate it was measured at.

warmupRatio.description: Fraction of the run's optimizer steps spent warming up. Exclusive upper bound: a warmup covering every step leaves no step for the schedule that follows it, so 1.0 would describe a run whose declared schedule never takes effect.

warmupSteps.description: Warmup expressed in optimizer steps instead of a ratio. Steps are counted on optimizer updates, not micro-batches, so the value does not shift when gradient accumulation changes.

earlyStopping.description: Absent means disabled, and absence is the ONLY way to say disabled. A `patience: 0` spelling would be a second representation of the same state, and two spellings of off is how a run ends up stopping for a reason nobody selected.

patience.description: Consecutive epochs without a qualifying improvement before the run stops. 1 stops at the first such epoch.

minDelta.description: How much validation loss must fall to count as an improvement and reset patience. 0.0 means any decrease counts.

restoreBestAdapter.description: When true the published artifact is the adapter from the best validation epoch rather than the last completed one. Recorded here because the two are different artifacts and nothing downstream could otherwise tell which was published.

training.$comment: A warmup without a declared schedule leaves the post-warmup shape unstated, so it is not accepted on its own. The new controls are otherwise optional: the finetuner's Job.to_dict() emits them as it gains them, and a document from before it did must keep validating.

not.description: Both spellings of warmup at once is ambiguous, and the ambiguity is silent: whichever the runtime happens to read wins and the document still looks well-formed.

$comment: datasetDir and outputDir are deliberately NOT part of this document, which is why additionalProperties is false rather than permissive. They are container-local mount points supplied by the platform, carry no meaning outside the Job, and this document is user-visible — paths are incidental infrastructure detail that should not leak into it.
